security.design: Public RPC wrappers use security invoker. Scoped writers are private-schema definers with fixed empty search paths, explicit auth.uid/current membership checks and no anonymous execute. Public tables grant authenticated SELECT only; RLS restricts current task/project generation and inbox recipient. Private receipts grant no direct client access.
security.newFindings: Two intentional authenticated GraphQL schema-discoverability findings for task_comments/task_mentions. No new anonymous table exposure or exposed security-definer finding. RLS protects rows; table names/column names are intentionally discoverable after sign-in.

performance.newFindings: One unused-index observation on the newly created comment author FK index. Retained for account-deletion maintenance; empty/tiny rollback fixtures do not establish production index usage. No new unindexed FK or RLS initplan finding.
